description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Translation' model class within the OpenCart admin system, providing methods to add, edit, delete, and retrieve translation records from the database.

classes.name: Translation
classes.description: A model class managing translation records, including CRUD operations and filtering within the database.

methods.name: addTranslation
methods.description: Creates a new translation record in the database with provided data.

methods.name: editTranslation
methods.description: Updates an existing translation record identified by its ID with new data.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a translation record based on its ID.

methods.name: deleteTranslation
methods.description: Deletes a translation record specified by its ID.

methods.name: deleteTranslationsByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all translation records associated with a specific store.

methods.name: deleteTranslationsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all translation records associated with a specific language.

methods.name: getTranslation
methods.description: Retrieves a specific translation record by ID.

methods.name: getTranslations
methods.description: Fetches a list of translation records with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalTranslations
methods.description: Returns the total count of translation records, with optional filtering.
